name: Liquity
description: Liquity V2 is an immutable borrowing protocol where users open positions (troves) against ETH and liquid-staking tokens to mint the BOLD stablecoin at an interest rate they choose themselves. Liquity AG runs no official frontend; interfaces are operated by third parties.
description_zh: Liquity V2 是一个不可变的借款协议，用户以 ETH 和流动性质押代币开立仓位（trove），按自己选择的利率铸造 BOLD 稳定币。Liquity AG 不运营官方前端，界面由第三方运营。
